prose: Oliver Brusca is the man behind the music of VOLO, who has crafted an ethereal selection of uplifting and artful audio odysseys. Tonight we'll discover what makes his metronome tick and explore thoughts on the role of music in society. Joining us once again is the greatest bassist in our band, music theory teacher and podcaster Jorge Mesa.
